in_greek.name: Ἀλβερτίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Albertina in Greek is derived from the word 'alberto' which means 'noble, exalted one'. This name was popular among the ancient Greeks and Romans and was often given to girls who were considered to be of high birth or noble lineage.

in_latin.name: Albertina
